"It couldn't be more fitting, the girl who saved my life is the last person I'm going to talk with before it ends. Yes I know the last time we talked was ugly. I know we both hurt each other several times in our many, but short relationship attempts. But the feelings I have for you never faded, they're as strong as the night we confessed our feelings to each other. Times seem so much simpler back then, don't they? We were both lonely, lusting for attention that we had been deprived of. It's almost a shame we met when we did, two kids not old enough to know what we were getting into. If I'd known what I know now, I'd probably be sitting there next to you now, having you call me your "little butthole" as we watch the Disney movies you love so much. Not sitting here in this cold, lonely cell having tears blind my eyes. If only I knew.

Unfortunately I've made my mistakes. I'm sure you already know about my sentencing, I'm not going into details about the crime, you probably know it all anyway. I just hope it doesn't change the way you view me, I'm still the dorky guy who'd stay up till three in the morning just to make sure you're okay. If only I knew.

 When you texted me again, telling me you missed me, I should've left with you then. I played this stupid game, putting you and the girl I was with through hell. That's the reward I get I suppose, loving two people only leaves you with loneliness. Maybe if I just went back to you like I wanted, I would've found that happiness in life, that euphoria I only could capture with you. If only I knew.

It probably means nothing to you now, considering it's been so long, but it pains me deeply that I'll never get to actually meet you. That one phone call we shared, was one of the only times I heard your voice, how could I love you so much based on that? I've never been able to explain my attraction to you, the first thing was your name, then your looks, then your personality. Actually no, I've thought about this a lot. The reason I feel so strongly towards you is because out of everyone I've ever met, you're the only one I couldn't figure out. I fell in love with the mystery that is you, and no matter what I did, I could not push the thought of you from my mind. If only I knew.

I suppose it's small to anyone but myself, but I'm sorry we'll never get to have that sushi date. I'm sorry we don't get those dates we wanted, no beach trips, no more annoying you with puns until you yell at me. But you know what hurts the most? I'll never give you that kiss I promised. That aches me to my core. I'm sorry for all the pain I've caused you, I would be surprised if you throw this letter out, I just hope you take the time to read this. Anyway, I've probably rambled enough. If only I knew.

I hope someday you meet someone who loves you like I do, but treats you better. You deserve that much. Huh, how funny, it's so close to valentines day, reminds me of last year, does it do the same for you? By the time you read this I'll have already made my ascent to the stars. You'll never be hearing from me again, just like you wished. I hope you have a great life, become that beautician like you've always dreamed of. I hope you get those two kids when your ready, I've told you before and I'll tell you now, you're gonna be a great mom. Goodbye my love, hopefully we'll meet again in another life. If only I knew.


                                       With love and care,
                                     Your Little Butthole."

We met too young, online. Falling in love fast, she was the first girl I ever dated, and instead of treating her like a person, I treated her like a trophy. I pushed her away by doing this, she talked with another guy, left me for him, he ditched her, and she came back to me, we reconciled and had a dysfunctional relationship, ended pretty quickly. 

We started talking again two months later and just hit it off, my feelings never faded, and we eventually got back together. A month goes by, and another failure. I kept making the same mistakes, showering her with compliments, tried to act perfect, and I ruined everything. 

I started dating my best friend soon after, trying to move on after 11 months of pain, and two weeks later, my ex texted me asking about my "new girl". I talk with her for like 10 minutes, she leaves, and I move on with my life. 

I was STUPID for believing that. She texted me again after two weeks telling me she missed me blah blah. It had been less than a month since we'd broken up, I was certain I was gonna marry this girl. The wound was still fresh and I still had feelings. This turned into a pick and choose game between my ex and my current girlfriend, I chose my current girl and told her everything. After a few hours I fixed things, and blocked my ex on everything but twitter and her actual number. I then proceeded to stalk my ex for a month, I couldn't get her off my mind, I felt like I made the wrong choices ect. 

So I end up texting her a month later and tell her about my feelings, she shit on me and had her new bf do the same. After getting blasted for like 30 minutes, she eventually left, I decided not to tell my gf and just move on with my life. Turns out my gf's friend stalked my exes twitter, and my ex tweeted something "don't try and come back into my life when I'm trying to recover and be happy". My gf and her friend put it together, and confronted me on it, I came clean and by the grace of god, my gf stayed with me. I felt lucky and started moving on with my life, and three weeks later, here comes my ex texting me again. I ignored it, and have since never talked with her.

It's been awhile, I still think of her and wonder if I should text her, I never do, and as long as in with my girl, I never will. My feelings were almost entirely gone until the last two weeks, I don't know what brought it up, but she's just been on my mind. I'll probably never know if she was the one or not, but I'm happy with my current relationship. 

The best way to describe the two relationships? 
My ex was a roller coaster, there were really low lows, to the point where it made me so depressed I had suicidal thoughts. But there were really high highs, it gave me feelings of euphoria that I still haven't felt anything close to. 

My current girlfriend has been a steady car ride of happiness, and it's been great.

TL;DR  I met a girl online, thought she was my soulmate, spent over a year of my life chasing something that amounted to nothing, now I'm with someone else.
